a.text: Being upfront rather than springing a surprise: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) only works if two storms in a row miss. That's about 4% for each of us. The reserve already holds 4, enough for one unit right now. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. If you take too, the random split probably leaves us both short, so please weigh that. If no storm comes, I'll operate with you every round after that to help you reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
